corporate-gifting-company.intro: Among corporate gifting companies in India, Nalanda Enterprises has spent 12 years doing one thing well: helping HR, admin and procurement teams buy branded gifts in bulk without the usual back-and-forth. From our base in Sector 19D, Chandigarh, we have served 500+ corporate clients and delivered over 50,000 gifts across the country. You get a catalogue of 12,410 products from 54 authorised brands, verified MRPs on every item and a single point of contact from quote to dispatch.

sections.h2: What to Look For in a Corporate Gifting Partner
sections.body:
Most buyers shortlisting corporate gift suppliers compare three things: product range, pricing transparency and reliability at scale. A partner with a narrow catalogue forces you into generic items, while one without verified pricing makes it hard to justify a purchase order internally.

Our catalogue spans audio, wearables, power banks, kitchen and home appliances, dinnerware, luggage, watches, home textiles and fitness products. Every listing carries a verified MRP, so finance teams can see the value of what employees or clients receive, and bulk pricing below MRP is shared on request based on quantity. Because the range sits under one roof, a single order can combine a boAt speaker for the sales team, a Prestige cookware set for long-serving staff and a Cello flask set for plant workers, all on one proposal and one invoice.

Buying through a corporate gifting agency should not feel like running a tender every time. Our process is deliberately short. You message your requirement, budget per head and approximate quantity on WhatsApp at +91-9115513366. We reply with a curated proposal of options that fit, including bulk rates and availability.

Once you confirm, we raise the order, arrange logo branding or custom packaging where the product allows it, and dispatch from Chandigarh with a proper GST invoice. In-stock items typically move within a few working days; branded or customised orders take longer, and we tell you the expected window upfront. MOQs vary by product, though many items start around 25-50 units. For teams used to juggling several corporate gift vendors, having one accountable supplier for sourcing, invoicing and dispatch saves real admin time.

Our corporate gifting services are built around recurring programmes rather than one-off purchases. We regularly handle employee onboarding kits, rewards and recognition, Diwali and festival programmes, client appreciation gifts branded to the company, channel partner and dealer rewards, and sales incentive schemes.

Each industry tends to need something different. Pharma and healthcare firms often gift field teams and doctors practical electronics; FMCG and manufacturing companies reward distributors and shop-floor staff; IT and BFSI teams lean towards wearables, audio and work-from-home gear; education, hospitality and retail buyers usually prefer home and kitchen items with broad appeal. We put together budget-tiered curation for each, so one programme can have a Rs. 500 tier, a Rs. 2,000 tier and a premium tier, all sourced from the same authorised catalogue.

faqs.q: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
faqs.a: Our office is at SCF-4, Sector 19D, Chandigarh. If you are searching for corporate gifts near me in the tricity, you are welcome to discuss requirements in person. Buyers elsewhere in India work with us over WhatsApp, phone and email, and we deliver pan-India from Chandigarh.

faqs.q: Are you a reseller or authorised for the brands you sell?
faqs.a: The 54 brands in our catalogue, including boAt, Noise, Philips, Havells, Prestige, Titan and Samsung, are authorised brands for us. This matters for genuine products, valid warranties and proper GST billing, which is why procurement teams prefer us over unverified corporate gift dealers.

faqs.q: How do you decide pricing for bulk orders?
faqs.a: Every product has a verified MRP. For bulk orders we quote dealer-level pricing below MRP, and the discount depends on the product and the quantity you need. Share your budget per gift and head count, and we will propose options that fit it.

faqs.q: Can you handle gifts for different employee levels in one order?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients ask for budget-tiered curation, with separate options for junior staff, managers and leadership. We combine all tiers on a single proposal and GST invoice, which keeps approvals, payment and dispatch tracking simple for HR and procurement.

promotional-gifts.meta_description: Promotional gifts from 54 authorised brands, with logo branding on many items on request. Bulk rates below MRP and GST invoices. Ask for a quote today.
promotional-gifts.intro: Promotional gifts work best when people actually keep and use them, which is why we focus on useful, branded products rather than throwaway trinkets. Nalanda Enterprises supplies marketing teams, event managers and sales heads with bottles, power banks, earphones, backpacks and other everyday items from 54 authorised brands. With 12 years in the business and more than 50,000 gifts delivered, we help you pick items that suit your audience, fit the campaign budget and carry your logo where the product allows.

sections.body:
The best promotional products are the ones a customer reaches for every day. A Cello water bottle sits on a desk for months; a Portronics charging cable travels in a bag; a boAt neckband goes on every commute. Each of those moments is a quiet brand impression.

When planning, think about who receives the gift and where they will use it. Trade-show visitors appreciate compact, portable items. Retail customers respond to kitchen and home pieces. Corporate buyers value tech accessories. For giveaway items for promotion at scale, lighter products also keep courier costs sensible. Tell us the audience and the campaign goal, and we will shortlist items across categories so you can compare options side by side before committing to a quantity.

Promotional items with logo branding are available on many products in our catalogue, on request. Bottles, flasks, backpacks, power banks and some tech accessories are the usual candidates, though the method and minimum quantity vary by item, so we confirm feasibility during the proposal stage.

The ordering flow is straightforward. Send your requirement on WhatsApp, and we respond with a proposal showing products, verified MRPs, bulk pricing and branding options. After you approve the artwork and quantities, we place the order and dispatch from Chandigarh with a GST invoice. MOQs vary by product, with many starting around 25-50 units. In-stock plain items typically ship in a few working days; branded or customised orders need longer, and we share a realistic timeline before you confirm.

Marketing budgets rarely allow one price point for everyone. We usually structure promotional corporate gifts in tiers. Entry-level items such as cables, basic earphones and Cello bottles suit large walk-in audiences and contests. Mid-range pieces like power banks, Bluetooth speakers and insulated flasks work well for key customers and channel partners. Premium picks from brands like Noise, Titan or Swiss Military are kept for top accounts or lucky-draw winners.

If you are specifically hunting for promotional gift items under 100 rupees, be aware that branded products at that level are limited; we will tell you honestly what is feasible and suggest the nearest useful alternative. For marketing gifts aimed at retaining existing customers, a slightly higher per-unit spend on a genuine branded product usually delivers better recall than a larger quantity of unbranded giveaways.

faqs.q: Which products are most popular for promotions?
faqs.a: Water bottles and flasks, charging cables, power banks, earphones, backpacks and small kitchen items are consistently popular because recipients use them daily. We recommend choosing based on your audience and event format; we can suggest a shortlist once you share the campaign details.

faqs.q: Can every product carry our logo?
faqs.a: No. Logo branding is available on many products, on request, but not on all of them. Some brands and product surfaces do not allow it. We confirm branding feasibility, method and any minimum quantity for each item during the proposal stage.

faqs.q: Do you work as a promotional gifts supplier for events outside Chandigarh?
faqs.a: Yes. We are based in Chandigarh and deliver pan-India. Event kits and campaign stock are dispatched to your office or venue with a GST invoice. In-stock items typically take a few working days; branded orders take longer, so plan ahead of the event date.

faqs.q: What quantity do we need to order?
faqs.a: MOQs vary by product, and many items start around 25-50 units. Branded or customised orders may need higher quantities. Share your campaign size and we will suggest items where your quantity works comfortably, along with bulk pricing below MRP.

luxury-corporate-gifts.meta_description: Luxury corporate gifts from Bose, Marshall, Sennheiser, Titan and Samsung for clients and CXOs. Verified MRPs, GST invoices. Request a curated proposal.
luxury-corporate-gifts.intro: Luxury corporate gifts carry a message that ordinary gifts cannot: that the relationship matters. Whether you are thanking a key client, welcoming a new director or recognising a leadership team, Nalanda Enterprises helps you choose genuinely premium products from authorised brands such as Bose, Marshall, Sennheiser, Titan, Samsung and Swiss Military. Every item carries a verified MRP, so the value is clear, and our team handles sourcing, presentation and dispatch so your gift arrives the way it should.

sections.body:
At the top end, the product itself does most of the talking. Premium electronic gifts are a safe choice because they are used daily and signal quality instantly. A Bose or Sennheiser headphone, a Marshall speaker, a Samsung tablet or an Amazon Echo device suits most senior recipients.

For luxury tech gifts with a lifestyle angle, consider smartwatches, premium TWS earbuds or a Titan watch. Travel-heavy executives appreciate quality luggage from Safari, VIP or Swiss Military. Home-focused picks, such as a La Opala dinner set or a Philips kitchen appliance, work well when the gift is meant for the family as much as the individual. We usually suggest two or three options per recipient profile so you can choose the right balance of utility and prestige.

sections.h2: Gifting to Clients, CEOs and VIPs
sections.body:
Selecting corporate gifts for CEO-level recipients or long-standing client partners needs a little more thought than a standard employee order. Consider the recipient's travel habits, whether the gift will sit in an office or at home, and any compliance rules their organisation has on gift value.

For VIP gifts for clients, we often recommend a single high-quality product rather than a crowded hamper. Luxury gift hampers India buyers request can still be assembled, for example pairing a premium speaker with a smart home device, but restraint usually looks more refined. Client appreciation gifts can be branded to your company on many products, on request, typically through packaging or a message card rather than a visible logo on the product itself, which keeps the gift feeling personal rather than promotional.

High-value orders deserve careful handling from the start. You share recipient profiles, budget and timing on WhatsApp, and we prepare a proposal with verified MRPs, bulk pricing below MRP where quantity allows, and availability for each option.

Once you approve, we place the order, coordinate any custom packaging requested, and dispatch from Chandigarh with a GST invoice. In-stock premium items typically ship within a few working days; customised or branded presentation takes longer, so we recommend starting two to three weeks before the gifting date for large client lists. Because luxury items are usually ordered in smaller quantities, we can also mix several different products across one order, letting you match each gift to the individual rather than sending the same item to everyone.

faqs.q: What brands do you offer for executive gifts?
faqs.a: For senior leaders we most often recommend Bose, Marshall, Sennheiser, Samsung, Lenovo, Titan, Amazon Echo, Swiss Military, Safari and La Opala. All are among the 54 authorised brands in our catalogue, so products are genuine and billed with a GST invoice.

faqs.q: Can we order premium corporate gifts for employees too?
faqs.a: Yes. Many companies use premium tiers for long-service awards, top performers or leadership offsites. We can set up a separate premium tier alongside a standard employee gift in the same programme, with one proposal and one invoice.

faqs.q: Do you offer custom packaging for luxury gifts?
faqs.a: Custom packaging and message cards are available on many products, on request. We confirm what is possible for each item during the proposal, and customised presentation adds some time to dispatch, so share your gifting date early.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum order for premium gifts?
faqs.a: MOQs vary by product. Many items start around 25-50 units for bulk rates, but premium gifting often involves smaller, mixed quantities. Share your list and we will advise what pricing is possible for the quantity you need.

sections.h2: Delivery Across India, Including Multiple Addresses
sections.body:
Hybrid teams and distributed client lists mean gifts rarely go to one address anymore. We handle corporate gift delivery to multiple addresses, whether that is a handful of regional offices or individual employee homes, dispatched from Chandigarh.

For corporate gifts home delivery, share a clean address list with names and phone numbers, and we will plan dispatch accordingly. In-stock items typically reach recipients in a few working days; branded or customised orders take longer. We do not offer corporate gifts same day delivery, and we would rather set honest expectations than overpromise. Every consignment is billed with a proper GST invoice, and larger orders can be split by location on request, which helps finance teams allocate costs across branches or cost centres.

sections.h2: Why Buyers Prefer Us to Retail Sites
sections.body:
Consumer shopping sites are fine for one gift, but they struggle with fifty or five hundred. Stock runs out mid-order, invoices arrive in dozens of pieces, and nobody helps with branding or tiered budgets.

As a dedicated corporate gift shop with 54 authorised brands, we give you consolidated billing, bulk rates below MRP and a single contact who knows your order. MOQs vary by product, though many items start around 25-50 units. We also support programmes rather than just transactions: onboarding kits, festival gifting, rewards and recognition, dealer incentives and client appreciation. If you need to send corporate gifts across India on a recurring basis, we can keep your preferred products and budget tiers on file so repeat orders move faster.

faqs.q: Can I place the full order on the website?
faqs.a: The website lets you browse products and verified MRPs. For bulk pricing and confirmation, we finalise orders through a quick WhatsApp or email conversation, which lets us check stock, confirm branding options and prepare a proper proposal and GST invoice.

faqs.q: Do you deliver corporate gifts with pan India delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver across India from our base in Chandigarh. In-stock items typically arrive within a few working days, while branded or customised orders take longer. We share an expected window with the proposal.

faqs.q: Can gifts be sent directly to employees' homes?
faqs.a: Yes. Share a list with recipient names, addresses and phone numbers, and we will plan individual dispatches. This is common for remote teams and festival programmes. Billing remains consolidated on a GST invoice for your company.

faqs.q: How do I pay for an online corporate order?
faqs.a: Once you approve the proposal, we confirm the order and share payment details along with the invoice. Payment terms are discussed at the proposal stage. All orders are billed with a GST invoice to your company.

sections.h2: Gift Ideas for Openings and Launches
sections.body:
For a new office opening gift that guests will remember, choose something that works at home as well as at work. Table clocks and watches from Titan, compact Bluetooth speakers, Philips or Havells kettles, and La Opala serveware all feel appropriate for business guests without being overly personal.

Showroom inauguration gifts often go to dealers, walk-in customers and local dignitaries, so it helps to create two tiers: a modest token for general guests and a more substantial gift for key partners. Shop opening gift ideas that work well at scale include Cello flask sets, dinnerware pieces and insulated bottles. When planning gifts for new office opening client visits, a premium desk item or a small appliance usually strikes the right balance between courtesy and value.

Housewarming is one of the few occasions where practical home items are exactly what people want. Dinner sets from La Opala or Luminarc, Prestige cookware, Welspun bed linen and small kitchen appliances from Philips, Bajaj or Usha are safe, welcome choices.

For griha pravesh gifts, many buyers prefer something for the kitchen or pooja space, such as a quality dinner set or a serving collection. When a housewarming gift for colleague is being organised by a team, pooling a budget towards a single good appliance is often better than several small items. Housewarming gifts under 2000 rupees might include a Cello flask set, a Philips kettle or a set of La Opala bowls; we can shortlist options in your range from verified MRPs.

Inaugurations run to a fixed date, so timing matters more than usual. We suggest sharing your guest count and budget at least two weeks ahead, especially if you want custom packaging or a message card, which is available on many products on request.

The process is simple. Send the brief on WhatsApp, receive a proposal with options, bulk pricing below MRP and availability, confirm the order, and we dispatch from Chandigarh with a GST invoice. In-stock items typically ship within a few working days; customised orders take longer. MOQs vary by product, with many items starting around 25-50 units, though smaller mixed orders for VIP guests can also be arranged. We can deliver directly to the venue so gifts are ready on the day.

faqs.q: What is a good gift for guests at an office opening?
faqs.a: Useful items with broad appeal work best: Titan clocks, small kitchen appliances, La Opala serveware, Cello flask sets or compact speakers. We recommend a standard gift for all guests and a premium option for key clients or partners.

faqs.q: Can the gifts carry our company name?
faqs.a: Custom packaging, message cards or logo branding are available on many products, on request. Branding adds some lead time, so share your inauguration date early and we will confirm what is feasible for each product in the proposal.

faqs.q: Can you deliver gifts to the inauguration venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We dispatch from Chandigarh to venues across India. In-stock items typically take a few working days, and customised orders longer. Share the venue address and event date so we can plan dispatch with a comfortable buffer.

faqs.q: Do you have options for small guest lists?
faqs.a: Yes. While many products start around 25-50 units for bulk pricing, we also help with smaller mixed orders for VIP guests or senior partners. Share the guest breakdown and we will suggest suitable combinations.

work-anniversary-gifts.meta_description: Work anniversary gifts for 1, 5, 10 and 25-year milestones from Titan, Samsung, Philips and more. Tiered budgets, GST invoice. Plan your programme today.
work-anniversary-gifts.intro: Work anniversary gifts tell employees their years with the company have been noticed. Nalanda Enterprises helps HR teams build milestone programmes that scale sensibly, from a thoughtful token at year one to a genuinely valuable award at year twenty-five. With 54 authorised brands, including Titan, Samsung, Philips, Prestige and Swiss Military, you can match each milestone to a clear budget tier, keep gifts consistent across locations, and handle every order with one proposal and a GST invoice.

sections.body:
A tiered structure keeps service milestone gifts fair and easy to administer. For a 1 year work anniversary gift, useful everyday items work well: a Cello flask set, a boAt neckband, a Portronics power bank or a Noise fitness band.

A 5 year work anniversary gift should feel noticeably more substantial, for example a smartwatch, premium TWS earbuds, a Philips kitchen appliance or a Safari cabin trolley. By the time you reach a 10 year work anniversary gift, many companies move to items the whole family will use, such as a La Opala dinner set, a Prestige cookware set or a Samsung tablet. At 20 and 25 years, the gift becomes an heirloom-style statement: a Titan watch, premium audio from Bose or Sennheiser, or a major home appliance.

A long service award works best when it is predictable. Employees should know that milestones are recognised consistently, regardless of which office or plant they work in. We help HR teams set this up by fixing a product shortlist and budget per milestone, then fulfilling orders as dates come up through the year.

The workflow follows our standard process: share milestone lists on WhatsApp or email, receive a proposal with verified MRPs and bulk pricing below MRP, confirm, and we dispatch from Chandigarh with a GST invoice. In-stock items typically ship within a few working days. For 25 years service award gift presentations at an annual event, we can consolidate several milestones into one delivery. Logo branding or custom packaging is available on many products, on request, if you want the company name on the award.

Years of service gifts should suit the person receiving them, not just the budget. Field sales staff often appreciate travel gear and power banks; plant and warehouse teams value home appliances and kitchenware; desk-based employees may prefer audio, wearables or work-from-home gear.

Anniversaries also apply to managers. A work anniversary gift for boss, organised by the team, is usually best kept modest and practical, for instance a quality flask, a desk speaker or a Titan watch pooled from a group contribution. For senior leaders crossing major milestones, the company may want a more formal recognition item. We can prepare options across all these profiles in one proposal, letting HR pick per individual while keeping billing and dispatch consolidated.

faqs.q: What makes a good first-year anniversary gift?
faqs.a: Keep it useful and modest: a Cello flask set, a boAt neckband, a Portronics power bank, a Noise fitness band or a quality backpack. These are budget-friendly, widely liked, and leave room for bigger gifts at later milestones.

faqs.q: Can we set fixed gifts for each milestone year?
faqs.a: Yes. Many HR teams fix one or two products per milestone, such as 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 years. We keep the shortlist on file and fulfil orders monthly or quarterly, subject to stock, with a GST invoice each time.

faqs.q: Can the award carry our company logo?
faqs.a: Logo branding and custom packaging are available on many products, on request. For milestone awards, a branded box or message card is common. We confirm what is feasible for each product during the proposal stage.

faqs.q: Do you have work anniversary gift ideas India teams can use across locations?
faqs.a: Yes. We dispatch from Chandigarh to offices and homes across India, so a single programme works for every branch. In-stock items typically take a few working days; branded orders take longer.

wfh-kit.meta_description: Build a work from home kit for remote teams with audio, laptop stands, power banks and more. Delivery to employee homes across India. Request a proposal.
wfh-kit.intro: A well-planned work from home kit makes remote employees more productive and more connected to the company. Nalanda Enterprises assembles WFH kits for distributed teams using products from 54 authorised brands, including boAt, Portronics, Lenovo, DailyObjects, Belkin and Philips. We deliver directly to employee homes across India from Chandigarh, bill everything on one GST invoice, and help you choose components that fit your budget per head without compromising on the essentials.

sections.h2: What Goes into a Good WFH Kit
sections.body:
Start with the items that affect daily work. Audio comes first: a good headset or TWS earbuds make calls clearer and reduce fatigue. A laptop stand gift improves posture and is one of the most appreciated items in remote setups. A reliable power bank or multi-port charger from Portronics, Belkin or WiWu helps during outages.

After that, add comfort and wellbeing items: a Cello insulated bottle or tumbler, a desk lamp, or a fitness accessory. For a fuller wfh essentials kit, some companies include a webcam, a keyboard-mouse combo or a backpack for days in the office. We suggest choosing four to six items around a clear theme, rather than filling the box with low-value extras that end up unused.

The practical challenge with gifts for remote employees is logistics. Collecting addresses, handling different cities and keeping track of deliveries can overwhelm an HR team. We simplify it: share a spreadsheet with names, addresses and phone numbers, and we plan dispatch from Chandigarh.

The order flow is the same as every programme we run. You send the brief and budget on WhatsApp, we return a proposal with verified MRPs, bulk pricing below MRP and stock position, you confirm, and we dispatch with a GST invoice. In-stock kits typically reach homes within a few working days; kits with custom packaging or logo branding, available on many products on request, take longer. MOQs vary by product, though many items start around 25-50 units, which suits most team sizes.

sections.h2: Kits for Hybrid and Onboarding Use
sections.body:
Remote team gifts India companies send are not just for fully remote staff. Hybrid work gift ideas often combine home and commute needs: a laptop backpack, a neckband for travel, a power bank and a tumbler that works at both desks.

WFH kits also double as onboarding kits. New joiners who start remotely appreciate receiving their essentials in the first week, and a consistent kit gives them the same first impression as office-based colleagues. We can set up a standard kit and fulfil it in batches as new employees join. For recognition moments, a smaller top-up kit with one premium item, such as a Noise smartwatch or Sennheiser headset, works well as a reward for gifts for remote workers who have delivered strong results.

faqs.q: What is a typical budget for a WFH kit for employees?
faqs.a: It depends on the items. A basic kit with a bottle, charger and earphones sits at the lower end, while kits with a quality headset, laptop stand and power bank cost more. Share your budget per head and we will build options within it.

faqs.q: Can you ship WFH kits to employees in different cities?
faqs.a: Yes. We dispatch from Chandigarh to employee homes across India. In-stock kits typically arrive within a few working days, while customised kits take longer. You get consolidated billing on one GST invoice.

faqs.q: Can the kit box be branded with our logo?
faqs.a: Custom packaging and logo branding are available on many products, on request. We confirm branding options in the proposal and share the additional lead time so kits still arrive on schedule.

faqs.q: Are home office gifts suitable for onboarding new hires?
faqs.a: Yes. These kits work well as onboarding kits for remote or hybrid joiners. We can fix a standard kit and fulfil batches as new employees join, subject to stock availability.
